hero.title: About DROS
hero.subtitle: We do not build large models. We build the physical laws that constrain them.
hero.desc: In the frantic race toward AGI, the industry has built skyscrapers on the sand dunes of probabilistic models. DROS exists to pour the foundational physical concrete for Enterprise AI.

philosophy.title: Our Philosophy: Determinism > Probability
philosophy.desc:
We disdain patching 'hallucinations' by layering dozens of microservices, massive Vector DBs, and endless Prompt Engineering. True security should never be built on guesswork and probabilities.

We advocate for returning to OS-level primitives. Instead of trying to make the AI 'understand' the rules, we use pure memory mapping and bitwise operations to physically melt dangerous boundaries at runtime.

origin.title: Name Origin: Dharma Reasoning
origin.desc:
In ancient Eastern philosophy, Dharma represents the absolute laws that maintain cosmic order. We firmly believe that as AI attains autonomous capabilities (Agentic), it requires an absolute set of laws to govern its behavior.

The original conceptual name for DROS was the Dharma Reasoning Operation System, signifying that AI must reason and operate strictly within the boundaries of an absolute law. Today, this philosophy has evolved into the industry's most robust Deterministic Runtime Operating System.

niche.title: Positioning: The 'Switzerland' of AI
niche.desc:
We occupy a highly unique ecological niche in the AI supply chain:

1. We do not compete with OpenAI or Anthropic: We do not train foundational models.
2. We do not covet enterprise secrets: We are a Zero-Telemetry physical component.

We do only one thing: We sit as the absolutely neutral physical checkpoint between the 'Black-box Models' and 'Core Enterprise Data'. Once passing through DROS, even the most cunning malicious model is stripped of its ability to do harm.

vision.title: Ultimate Vision: The Standard AI Protocol
vision.desc:
Just as the internet era relies on TCP/IP for reliable transmission, and crypto relies on blockchain for consensus, the upcoming Agentic AI era requires a foundational protocol to ensure machine behavior never crosses the line.

Our vision is to make the DROS Vajra Contract the standard security credential mesh for global AI Agent communication. We aim for every future server to be equipped with a VajraClaw physical circuit-breaker by default.
